cards.name: Rock Ogre Grotto #1
cards.description: Protected by a solid body of rock, this creature throws a bone-shattering punch.

cards.name: Giant Soldier of Stone
cards.description: A giant warrior made of stone. A punch from this creature has earth-shaking results.

cards.name: Ancient Jar
cards.description: A fragile jar from the past containing a mysterious creature.

cards.name: Haniwa
cards.description: An earthen doll that protects the treasure in the tombs of the ancient kings.

cards.name: Dissolverock
cards.description: A monster born from the lava pits. Generates intensive heat that can melt away its enemies.

cards.name: Stone Armadiller
cards.description: With a body armored by rock hard fur, this monster features excellent defense capabilities.

cards.name: Rock Ogre Grotto #2
cards.description: A stone golem that turns opponents in to rocks and then crushes them.

cards.name: Labyrinth Wall
cards.description: Walls appear on the field to form a labyrinth with no exit.

cards.name: Stone D.
cards.description: With a body consisting entirely of rocks, this dragon flings boulders at its enemies.

cards.name: Millennium Golem
cards.description: A golem that has protected treasure for nearly millennium.

cards.name: Destroyer Golem
cards.description: A golem with a massive right hand for crushing its victims.

cards.name: Barrel Rock
cards.description: A monster that charges into enemies firing a pair of cannons mounted on its shoulders.

cards.name: Stone Ghost
cards.description: A creature that erupts with anger, resulting in a crushing rain of boulders.

cards.name: Prisman
cards.description: A clear crystal that focuses light to create a powerful laser beam.

cards.name: The Statue of Easter Island
cards.description: A massive stone idol from Easter Island that fires laser rings from its mouth.

cards.name: Muka Muka
cards.description: A monster that angers an opponent to the point that the enemy goes berserk.

cards.name: Sand Stone
cards.description: Appears from underground and attacks with long, snake-like tentacles.

cards.name: Mystical Sand
cards.description: Turns enemies to stone and crushes them to dust.

cards.name: Pot the Trick
cards.description: Not a very reliable sorcerer's servant.

cards.name: Morphing Jar
cards.description: A large jar that attacks nearby enemies by unleashing the monster it contains inside.

cards.name: The Thing That Hides In the Mud
cards.description: The appearance of this creature is preceded by the ground melting under an opponent's feet.

cards.name: Stone Ogre Grotto
cards.description: A rock giant consisting of massive boulders.
